name: ascii-art
blurb: Renders an image as stylized ASCII or Unicode characters.
description: Converts an image to ASCII art using various character sets (blocks, symbols, braille, etc.). Dynamically computes character based on pixel brightness.
use_when: Retro aesthetics, terminal-style interfaces, or artistic text overlays.
avoid_when: Accessibility-critical content (ASCII may obscure meaning); small images (poor resolution).
a11y: ASCII text output; screen readers will read character sequences literally.
